hints.title: Fix a prefix
hints.body: Choose one unused value for the next position, then recurse on the rest.

hints.title: Undo the choice
hints.body: Remove the chosen value after the recursive call so it is available for other branches.

hints.title: Lexicographic order
hints.body: Sort the input and always try unused values from left to right.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort nums
backtrack(path, used):
    if len(path) == len(nums): record path; return
    for i from 0 to n-1:
        if used[i]: continue
        used[i] = true
        path.append(nums[i])
        backtrack(path, used)
        path.pop()
        used[i] = false
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
